# `output` is a declared component carrying a #[builtin] mark, so a package
# declaring its own takes the name back: the node is instantiated and the
# package has no build directive.
#
# While the name was matched literally the node was read as a directive and
# dropped -- `main` rendered nothing and the build said nothing, which is why
# this asserts what reaches the generated code rather than that the check is
# clean.

sngl dump --stage checked app.sngl
stdout 'output\(label="hi"\)'

sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out out app.sngl
grep '"hi"' out/model.go

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component output(label string) {
    text(value=label)
}

component main {
    output(label="hi")
}
